    s.XCL_042 AS charter_number,
    AVG(ss.XCL_039) AS average_writing_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.XCL_041 = ss.XCL_030
WHERE ss.XCL_039 > 499
GROUP BY s.XCL_041, s.XCL_042
ORDER BY AVG(ss.XCL_039) DESC
